comments: '64 x 400G QSFP56-DD 2RU spine switch on a Broadcom Tomahawk 4 with an Intel Xeon D-1548, sold
  as the DCS520 and stamped AS9736-64D. ALL PORTS ARE ON THE FRONT in TWO BANKS OF SIXTEEN STACKED COLUMNS,
  numbered from 1, with the legend `N (up)(down) N+1` printed BETWEEN the two cages of each column. Two
  10G SFP+ management cages at the left are ports 65 and 66; five system lamps stand in a column above
  them; an RJ-45 console, an RJ-45 management jack and a USB Type-A stack at the right. SIXTEEN OF THE
  SIXTY-FOUR ARE 24 W PORTS and the datasheet names them one by one. It is the fourth device on the 440
  x 649.2 x 87 shell and THE ONLY ONE OF THE FOUR WHOSE REAR PUTS A SUPPLY AT EACH END with the four fan
  trays between them - the AIS800-64D, the AIS800-64O and the AGR560 all stack two supplies at the left.
  One shell, two rear architectures.
